title: E Bike Rental in Hood River
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our location is an amazing starting point that is great for getting comfortable with your e-bike. The Hood River Waterfront is the hub for excitement for visitors to our town. Go check out windsurfing, kiteboarding, coffee shops, breweries, all within blocks from our shop. Local Staff will help introduce you to your electric bike and provide you with route directions. You will be using brand new Cannondale Bicycles which feature high Bosch Motors and Batteries. The route map we provide takes you through downtown Hood River and up through the car-free twin tunnels section of the historic highway. Expansive views await along this beautiful route as well as a twin-tunnel built in the 1920's. Route options include riding past cherry, pear, and apple orchards and stunning views of Mt. Hood.
